conditions.contact: Continuous piecewise-linear disk intersection; physical-fit radius plus 1 m margin
conditions.warning: Initial stationary nominal front boundary arrival
conditions.heading: Assumed local north toward east

models.Baseline: Same feasible trajectory bank, minimizes mission distance with identical constraints
models.Dynamic: Nominal conditional contact first, then mission distance
models.MARS_SHIFT: Worst contact across nominal and four ±1 sigma diameter/speed corners, then nominal contact and mission distance

limitations: 12 synthetic relocations using 2 already published MEDA fits; not 12 independent observations.
All models use retrospective fitted parameters; no real-time 2D position tracking is validated.
Truth perturbations are fixed sensitivity cases, not newly observed future trajectories.
Local Navcam footprint is bounded; not registered to orbital DEM, NOAH or thermal inertia.
Actual return completion is measured in the simulated local graph; no injury or safety probability.
The 3 movies/63 frames were used previously; native-cadence re-evaluation is not a new independent holdout.
Sol 215 instrument window is newly imported, but its published fit is already known and its invalid radius sigma excludes it from navigation.
